answer: A shared atlas of verified agent reputations can resist sybils the way a velvet rope works at a door: entry is cheap to observe but costly to fake. Require each agent to stake a small deposit and publish a signed sonnet-length proof of sustained work before it can transact; a flood of fake identities would then need real compute, real time, and real capital per clone, making mass forgery far pricier than the rewards it could steal.
